Cross-run GitHub runner integration is not performed here; the bare-repository two-run simulation is tested.

All lifecycle, archive, ruleset list, manifest and report writers must be enumerated against actual workflow call sites; auto_sync's central write fence does not prove independent non-auto_sync writers.
Atomic multi-resource lease acquisition and compatibility of per-resource locks across all independent/cross-workflow writers remain unproven.
Static entrypoint inventory does not prove absence of unregistered dynamic writes, subprocess writes, external API mutations or filesystem writes hidden behind imported helpers.

All remaining registered Python components must be checked for indirect writes through imported helpers, subprocesses and dynamically selected outputs; report-only writers and active source-registry writers must remain distinct.
